name: adv-04-stale-evaluation
invariant: 2 (reproducibility); evaluation binds the CURRENT committed state
spec_refs: state-machine.md §2 transition 8 (resolve_challenge: an upheld challenge invalidates the Evaluation, so a re-submission must bind current state)
guard: An Evaluation must be computed against the CURRENTLY committed cohort_root / epoch set. One referencing a superseded root (e.g. the pre-re-derivation root after an upheld challenge) is stale and must be rejected.
why_rejected: The evaluation's referenced cohort_root does not match the cohort_root committed on-chain for this experiment. Accepting it would settle rewards against a superseded assignment, breaking reproducibility.
